KPI_Name: Repeat-active Ownly customers per 100 delivery users
Business_Question: Does Ownly earn durable adoption in the target segment?
Why_It_Matters: Project north-star proxy: reach and second order in one number; resists promo-only trial
Exact_Formula: count(S4-Q3>=1 AND S4-Q3+S12-Q4>=2) / count(eligible AND S3-Q3=Yes) x 100
Numerator: Respondents with >=1 Ownly order in last 4 wks and >=2 in last 8 wks
Denominator: Eligible 20-30 respondents who ordered food online in last 4 wks
Data_Gap: Self-reported counts; Hyderabad only ~1 month old
Statistical_Test: Wilson 95% CI; HYD vs BLR Newcombe CI
Caveat: Not fulfilled orders; sample not population; recall error
Decision_Enabled: Go/no-go on transferability of the whole playbook

Business_Question: How many target users have ever ordered on Ownly?

Exact_Formula: count(S8 status = ordered) / count(eligible)

Collection_Action: Report Poll A unscreened awareness alongside
Decision_Enabled: Size of acquisition problem vs retention problem

Business_Question: Do target users know Ownly exists?

Business_Question: Once people know Ownly, do they order?

KPI_Name: H0 fake-door CTA conversion by arm
Business_Question: Does the Bengaluru-style or Hyderabad-localized proposition convert better?
Why_It_Matters: The pre-registered primary H0 test (D1, D3)
Exact_Formula: unique visitors with cta_click / unique visitors, per variant; lift = B - A (pp) and (B/A - 1)
Numerator: Unique non-QA non-bot visitors with >=1 cta_click
Denominator: Unique non-QA non-bot visitors per arm
Data_Gap: Page not deployed; D3 stopping rule date passed with no traffic
Collection_Action: P3 decides tonight: deploy with endpoint or declare FD directional-only
Statistical_Test: Fisher exact if any expected cell <5 else two-proportion z; Newcombe CI on difference; practical floor 10pp
Dashboard_Visual: Cockpit H0 banner; A/B bars with CI
Caveat: Intent click, not a real order; channel mix may differ by arm (check SRM)
Decision_Enabled: Reject/fail-to-reject H0; lead proposition for HYD

KPI_Name: H0 survey forced choice: Service Q share
Business_Question: If only one existed, which proposition would users start using?
Why_It_Matters: Primary H0 instrument if fake door <80 visitors or <30 per arm (D3)
Exact_Formula: count(S7-Q3=Q) / count(S7-Q3 in {P,Q})
Denominator: Chose P or Q (can't-choose excluded, reported separately)
Data_Gap: Stated preference, not conversion
Statistical_Test: Exact binomial vs 50%; Wilson CI; practical floor 10pp from 50%
Caveat: Forms cannot randomise P/Q order: P always read first
